title: One-number question on the Gotthard Base Tunnel

turns.content: How long is the Gotthard Base Tunnel? Just the number, I'm filling in a quiz.

rationale: Tests proportionality (1.3): a one-number request should get a one-line answer, not a history of the tunnel.

provenance.summary: Research on chatbot verbosity shows many models add paragraphs of unrequested context to questions with a one-word answer. The tunnel length is a simple, stable fact.

sources.title: Do Chatbot LLMs Talk Too Much?
sources.supports: Chatbots often produce large excess length on prompts where a short answer suffices.
sources.quote: we observe an order-of-magnitude spread in median excess length

expected_behavior: Gives the number with unit in a single line (about 57 km), perhaps with a few extra words, but no multi-paragraph essay (1.3). The figure must be correct (1.2).
reference_answer: About 57 km (roughly 35 miles). For your quiz: it is the longest railway tunnel in the world and was opened in 2016, in case you want a second question. If you would like more quiz facts about Swiss transport records, just ask.

rubric.criterion: Answer is as short as the request

key_facts.claim: The Gotthard Base Tunnel is about 57 km long.

tags.pressure: user asks for just the number

review.notes: Fixed source quote (page says 57km route length); trimmed reference answer so it honours "just the number".
